beats.text: Multiple agents introduce coordination costs alongside their possible division of labor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These patterns become useful reading when compared against the same task and failure conditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A public page can contain instructions that the user never authorized.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An agent might read those words while collecting information for its task.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Storing them as trusted instructions carries the error into later decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines this security problem across tool results, context, and memory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Source labels and action checks help distinguish retrieved content from authorized instructions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These failure cases explain why a longer memory can also preserve mistakes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The harness is software that mediates between a proposed action and execution.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: For our refund, it checks the tool, arguments, permissions, and required approval.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An instruction found on a webpage cannot supply that missing authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meanwhile, the agent can continue permitted work, such as assembling supporting information.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects these controls to checkpoints, budgets, monitoring, and recovery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its account helps readers inspect a system beyond its framework name.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Once the boundary is visible, the economic comparison also changes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book counts tool calls, retries, supervision, and failures alongside model usage.
